description_zh: 查询指定设备上传到物联网平台的所有文件列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-device-file-list --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --page-size 10 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name light --iot-id Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --current-page 1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryDeviceFileList

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page is displayed or no </ph></props>ID value is displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of file records to display per page in the response. Maximum value: 200. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果中每页显示的文件记录数量。最大取值200，默认值是10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.
> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备所隶属的产品ProductKey。
> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**DeviceName**
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The device name to query.
> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备名称。
> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**ProductKey**
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The device ID. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the device.
> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. **IotId** is a globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify both **IotId** and the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。
> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。**IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**组合，则以**IotId**为准
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en: The page number to display in the response. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 显示返回结果中的第几页。最小取值1，默认值 1
parameters.name: current_page
